title: Venue flow
description: Who is hitting this venue's book, buyers or sellers of Up. Each trade is signed by who crossed the spread.

signed_notional_10s.label: Net flow 10s
signed_notional_10s.description: Dollars spent buying Up minus dollars spent selling it over the last ten seconds. Positive means buyers of Up are in a hurry.

signed_notional_60s.label: Net flow 60s
signed_notional_60s.description: The same net dollars over the last minute. Slower, but a run of one sign is a real lean.

flow_direction_10s.label: Flow direction 10s
flow_direction_10s.description: The sign of the ten-second flow once it clears a small threshold. Neutral when buyers and sellers are balanced.
